Subject: Re: AWS listing questions: AMI region parity & PrivateOffer entitlements

Thanks Vivek — adding details.

1) AMI / regional strategy (ops summary):
- We produce a base AMI for the model runtime and container assets. AWS requires region-scoped AMI IDs, so we register the image in each commercial region we support (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, eu-central-1). The build pipeline replicates and publishes the AMI with canonical naming; the customer selects region at deployment time.
- Technical tradeoffs: replicated AMIs are identical snapshots; there is no behavioral difference. For BYO-model SKUs where customers bring their own model weights, we publish a compatible runtime AMI and require the customer to upload weights to an S3 location in their account (instructions included).

2) PrivateOffer entitlements and trials:
- PrivateOffer entitlements can be scoped per account via the marketplace pricing/entitlement flow. We use Marketplace metering + an entitlement flag to gate trial access. That means we can enable a 30-day trial specifically for AcmeCorp without toggling global flags.
- Implementation note: we need to coordinate with the customer's procurement to provide the buyer-facing PrivateOffer link and a unique offer code. AWS then creates an entitlement record tied to that buyer account.

3) Procurement artifacts (what to upload):
- SOC2 pointer (hosted evidence URL) + contact for SOC3/attestation requests
- Data flow diagram (SaaSCo -> Redwood runtime -> optional VPC endpoints)
- Sample SLO/uptime language and support contacts
- AMI region mapping CSV (attached)

Next steps / action items:
- Vivek: confirm that the product-page footnote is OK to ship as-is or edited.
- Kimberly: review hero/one-liner and the pricing footnote below.
- Emily: share AcmeCorp legal contact and whether they require an NDA-first flow (we can do PrivateOffer NDA off-line).

Attachment: ami-region-map.csv (CSV) — includes AMI IDs per region for the current build.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ami-region-map.csv (csv)]
